scripts.compile: npm run compile:frontend && npm run compile:backend
scripts.watch:frontend: nodemon --watch frontend --watch commonTypes --watch vite.config.ts --watch scripts/copy-frontend.mjs --ext ts,tsx,js,mjs,json,html,css --exec "npm run compile:frontend"
scripts.watch:backend: nodemon --watch backend --watch commonTypes --ext ts,js,json --exec "npm run compile:backend && node dist/backend/server.js"
